title: Agentic World Action Models
summary: Recent world action models provide visual foresight and future prediction for robot manipulation, but lack explicit mechanisms for compositional skill reuse. Agentic robotics combines code-based planning and reasoning with reusable skills, but often lacks predictive grounding in physical dynamics. We introduce AW-0, an agentic world action model framework that integrates code-based planning with joint video and action prediction. We jointly model code, future video, and robot actions as three coupled generative streams within a unified mixture-of-transformers architecture. Within this architecture a code expert generates parameterized skill routines and control logic while video and action experts generate future visual states and low-level motor commands. Code serves two complementary roles: it structures multi-step prediction and control within the world model and represents skills as reusable programs for subsequent agentic execution. We further introduce an automated curation pipeline that labels robot and human video trajectories with aligned programs and consolidates recurring routines into reusable skill libraries. Evaluations on RoboTwin 2.0 and physical bimanual manipulation tasks show improved task performance over VLA and WAM baselines, alongside gains in language following, semantic reasoning and robustness, demonstrating that agentic code enables connection between planning, prediction and execution within WAMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AW-0，一个将基于代码的规划与联合视频和动作预测相结合的智能体世界动作模型框架。
AI.motivation: 现有的世界动作模型缺乏组合技能重用的显式机制，而智能体机器人技术则缺乏在物理动力学中的预测基础。
AI.method: 提出AW-0框架，在统一的混合Transformer架构中，将代码、未来视频和机器人动作建模为三个耦合的生成流。代码专家生成参数化技能例程和控制逻辑，视频和动作专家生成视觉状态和电机命令。此外，引入自动数据整理流水线以标注视频轨迹并构建可重用技能库。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin 2.0和物理双臂操作任务上的评估表明，相比VLA和WAM基线，该方法提升了任务性能，并在语言遵循、语义推理和鲁棒性方面取得进展。
AI.conclusion: 智能体代码能够在世界动作模型中有效连接规划、预测和执行。

title: Rethinking Video Autoencoders for Interactive World Models
summary: Video world models predict future frames from past frames and actions. They serve as simulators in which agents train, plan or are evaluated, and that humans can control interactively. They generate in the latent space of a video autoencoder, whose compression sets their cost per frame and how long each action waits to take effect. Yet world models often reuse the autoencoders of text-to-video generators, built for offline generation with no agent waiting and, without their training data and code, not retrainable at another compression. We therefore ask how, where and how much a world model should compress. We build CADRE, an open family of causal diffusion representation autoencoders spanning multiple spatio-temporal compressions. Its members differ only in a small bottleneck on frozen features and share a diffusion decoder self-distilled to one or a few steps. We train the same world model on each autoencoder in two domains, manipulation and navigation, with two environments each. CADRE forms most of the latency-quality frontier, especially with a moving camera. Our study also leads to four findings. At strong compression, a diffusion decoder is sharper than perceptual regression. In robot manipulation, temporal compression is more effective in the autoencoder than in the world model. Manipulation and navigation call for opposite compressions: temporal compression costs little when the camera is still, and spatial compression when it moves. Surprisingly, with a still camera, coarser spatial tokens hurt motion far more than image quality. Code, models and a live demo are at https://kyutai.org/blog/2026-10-21-cadre

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CADRE，一个因果扩散表示自编码器开源家族，旨在研究视频世界模型应如何、在何处以及压缩多少，并发现机械臂操作与导航任务需要相反的压缩策略。
AI.motivation: 当前视频世界模型通常复用文本到视频生成器的自编码器，这些自编码器专为离线生成而构建，导致每帧成本高且无法在不同压缩率下重新训练。本文旨在解决世界模型应如何、在何处以及压缩多少的问题。
AI.method: 作者构建了CADRE，这是一个涵盖多种时空压缩的因果扩散表示自编码器开源家族。其成员仅在冻结特征上的一个小瓶颈处有所不同，并共享一个自蒸馏的扩散解码器。作者在两个领域（操作和导航）的每个自编码器上训练了相同的世界模型。
AI.result: CADRE占据了大部分延迟-质量前沿，尤其是在移动摄像头时。研究还得出四项发现：在强压缩下，扩散解码器比感知回归更清晰；在机器人操作中，自编码器中的时间压缩比在世界模型中更有效；操作和导航需要相反的压缩策略；在固定摄像头下，更粗糙的空间token对运动的损害远大于对图像质量的损害。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型合适的时空压缩取决于特定任务（操作与导航）和摄像头移动性。使用像CADRE这样定制的自编码器可以优化视频世界模型中的延迟与质量权衡。

title: Temporal Exploration and Rendezvous via Weisfeiler-Leman Colorings
summary:
Temporal graphs are graphs whose edge relation changes in discrete time steps. The Temporal Exploration Problem (TEXP) asks for a temporal walk that visits all vertices. We show that every connected temporal graph with $n$ vertices can be explored in $O(qn\log^3(n))$ time steps, where $q$ is the number of vertex color classes induced by the 2-dimensional Weisfeiler-Leman (2-WL) coloring. For small $q$, our bound substantially improves on the known worst-case bound of $Θ(n^2)$ in general connected temporal graphs. A corresponding walk can be constructed in deterministic polynomial time. The upper bound is complemented by lower bounds of $Ω(n\log(n))$ when $q$ is constant and $Ω(qn)$ when $1 \leq q \leq n$.
  We also apply our techniques to the Temporal Rendezvous Problem (TRP), in which two agents that do not communicate have to meet on a vertex of the temporal graph. Our exploration algorithm yields that, with only polynomial-time computational power, the agents can meet in $O(n\log^3(n))$ time steps, leaving a gap of only $\log^2(n)$ to the known lower bound.
  Dogeas, Erlebach, Kammer, Meintrup, and Moses Jr. [ICALP'24] have shown an $O(rn^{1+ε})$ bound for TEXP, for every fixed $ε> 0$, where $r$ is the number of orbits, and an $O(n^{1+ε})$ bound for TRP. Both results require superpolynomial computation time. Our contribution improves upon these results in several ways. First, the dependence on $n$ in the upper bounds on the number of time steps is decreased from $n^{1+ε}$ to $n\log^3(n)$ for both TEXP and TRP. Second, for TEXP, we bound the number of time steps linearly by the parameter q, which is efficiently computable and upper bounded by $r$. Third, we provide novel deterministic polynomial-time algorithms for both TEXP and TRP.
comment: Full version of a paper accepted for publication at SODA 2027. 37 pages, 3 figures

AI.tldr: 本文利用二维Weisfeiler-Leman着色技术，改进了时序图探索问题（TEXP）和时序会合问题（TRP）的时间步长上界，并提出了确定性的多项式时间算法。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决时序图探索（TEXP）和时序会合（TRP）问题中已知最坏情况时间界限较高（如Theta(n^2)），以及现有算法需要超多项式计算时间的问题。
AI.method: 提出一种基于二维Weisfeiler-Leman (2-WL) 着色诱导的顶点颜色类数量q的探索算法，并在确定性多项式时间内构建遍历所有顶点的时序游走。
AI.result: 对于TEXP，将时间步长上界改进至O(qn log^3(n))并给出了相应的下界；对于TRP，实现了O(n log^3(n))的会合时间步长。相比以往研究，降低了对n的依赖并实现了多项式时间计算。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入2-WL着色参数，本文不仅显著改进了TEXP和TRP的理论时间界限，还首次为其提供了确定性的多项式时间算法，缩小了与已知下界的差距。

title: Environment Duels: A Microcosm of LLM Co-Evolution
summary: Through a tangle of real-world interactions, from synthetic training pipelines to data shared on the open web, frontier LLMs absorb what their predecessors and competitors create. How well does each model play its role in this ecosystem, as a creator and as a solver? We introduce Environment Duels, a dynamic agentic benchmark that evaluates both capabilities on interactive environments. Each model writes environments, each with a privileged hint, aiming for tasks that capable solvers fail without the hint and pass with it. Across nine frontier LLMs, solving and authoring prove to be distinct skills: the strongest solvers are not the strongest authors, while smaller models learn more from how others played and write the hardest environments and the most useful hints. Beyond the scores, the pairwise interactions form a microcosm of how models affect one another. Head-to-head outcomes are transitive and so yield a stable ranking; independent authors converge on the same designs; and in a reinforcement-learning study with Qwen3.8-27B, the learner's hint lift on an author's environments tracks how much training on those environments improves it on held-out reasoning and agentic benchmarks, whether the environments are its own or another model's. Each of these patterns has a counterpart in how models shape one another outside the duel. By staging these interactions under controlled conditions, Environment Duels offers a window onto how LLMs teach, challenge and learn from one another. Code is available at https://github.com/LLM-Duels/EnvDuels.

AI.tldr: 本文引入了一个动态智能体基准测试“Environment Duels”，以评估大型语言模型在交互式环境中作为创造者和解决者的双重能力，揭示了这两种技能的差异以及模型间的相互影响。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在探讨前沿大型语言模型在真实世界交互生态系统中作为创造者和解决者的表现如何，因为目前对模型间相互作用的机制了解不足。
AI.method: 作者提出了“Environment Duels”基准测试，要求模型编写带有特权提示的交互式环境，并让其他模型作为求解者尝试解决这些任务。研究涵盖九个前沿LLM，并使用Qwen3.8-27B进行了强化学习研究。
AI.result: 求解与编写环境是截然不同的技能；最强求解者并非最强作者，较小模型从他人交互中学习更多，并能编写出更难的环境和更有用的提示。此外，模型间的成对交互具有传递性，独立作者的设计趋于一致，且学习者在作者环境上的提示增益能有效预测其在其他基准测试上的训练改进效果。
AI.conclusion: Environment Duels在受控条件下提供了一个窗口，揭示了大型语言模型如何相互教学、挑战和学习，这些模式反映了模型在决斗之外相互塑造的方式。

title: The End of Consensus Research?
summary: Consensus is a fundamental problem in distributed computing and at the core of state machine replication (SMR). Despite decades of active human research, discovering practical low-latency solutions to the problem is still open, as it requires combining protocol knowledge, correctness reasoning, implementation, and experimental evaluation. We report on how AI helped us discover A-greement, a new consensus protocol for geo-replicated state machines that significantly outperforms state-of-the-art solutions. Averaged across six deployments with 5 or 9 replicas, A-greement reduces the mean latency of a geo-distributed key-value store over the fastest baseline by 12.2% and 33.3% on write-heavy and read-heavy workloads, respectively, and matches the fastest baseline on read-only workloads. A-greement combines lease-authorized local reads, direct client learning for leader-ordered writes, and a fast fixed-quorum per-key write path, selected according to network topology and workload. At the heart of our discovery lies AI-greement, an agent harness for the "autonomous" discovery, implementation, experimentation, and verification of candidate protocols. AI-greement integrates (1) a concept-oriented protocol knowledge base, (2) a modular implementation skeleton, and (3) a Lean-based verification framework with reusable safety definitions, reference specifications, and proofs. AI-greement is of independent interest: its Lean formalization uncovers several previously unreported vulnerabilities in existing consensus protocols, and it provides guidelines on how domain-specific harnesses can turn general-purpose coding agents into effective tools for (distributed) computing research. Yet we argue that human consensus experts remain essential before, during, and after the search: agents reshape the researcher's role rather than end consensus research.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了由AI辅助发现的新型低延迟共识协议A-greement，及其用于自主发现、实现和验证协议的智能体框架AI-greement。
AI.motivation: 在分布式计算中，为共识问题寻找实用的低延迟解决方案仍是一个未解难题，这需要深度融合协议知识、正确性推理、系统实现与实验评估。
AI.method: 提出了A-greement协议和AI-greement智能体框架。A-greement根据网络拓扑和工作负载，结合了租约授权本地读取、直接客户端学习的领导者写入及快速固定仲裁写入路径；AI-greement集成了概念导向的协议知识库、模块化实现骨架及基于Lean的验证框架，以实现候选协议的自主发现与验证。
AI.result: 在6个包含5或9个副本的部署中，与最快基线相比，A-greement在重写和重读工作负载上分别将地理分布式键值存储的平均延迟降低了12.2%和33.3%，且在只读工作负载上与基线持平；此外，AI-greement的Lean形式化发现了现有共识协议中多个未报告的漏洞。
AI.conclusion: 领域特定的智能体框架能够有效引导通用编码智能体进行分布式计算研究，重塑研究人员的角色，但在整个协议搜索与发现过程的前、中、后阶段，人类共识专家依然不可或缺。

title: Quant-Arena: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Quantitative Trading Research
summary: Quantitative research is an iterative loop: a researcher proposes a market hypothesis, implements it as an executable signal, tests it on historical data, and decides what to keep. Existing benchmarks score formulas, code, or individual trading decisions, leaving open whether large language models (LLMs) can complete this loop and produce strategies that work beyond the research period. We introduce Quant-Arena, a benchmark and public leaderboard for end-to-end quantitative research on real A-share market data. A model constructs features and stock-scoring code, receives feedback only on 2022--2023, and freezes one strategy for assessment on the sealed year 2024. A cash-account evaluator applies trading constraints and costs, including market impact estimated from a simulated order book. Scores are dominated by realized excess return and complemented by signal quality and the diversity of features used by the strategy. We evaluate nine frontier models, among which GPT-6 Astra scores highest; yet no model beats the equal-weight market in 2024. Quant-Arena is open to submissions from any model or agent harness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Quant-Arena，一个评估大型语言模型在真实A股市场数据上进行端到端量化研究闭环的基准和公开排行榜。
AI.motivation: 现有基准仅评估公式、代码或单个交易决策，未验证LLM能否完成从提出假设到测试策略的完整闭环，并生成在研究期外仍有效的交易策略。
AI.method: 提出Quant-Arena基准，模型构建特征和评分代码，仅在2022-2023年获得反馈，并将冻结的策略在封存的2024年数据上进行评估；评估包含交易约束、成本及模拟订单簿的市场影响，评分以超额收益为主，辅以信号质量和特征多样性。
AI.result: 评估了九个前沿模型，其中GPT-6 Astra得分最高，但在2024年没有任何模型能战胜等权重市场基准。
AI.conclusion: 目前尚无LLM模型能在端到端量化研究中击败市场基准；Quant-Arena现已开放提交，以供评估任何模型或智能体框架。

title: Multimodal Embodied Agents: A Unified Capability-centric Perspective from Computer-Use to Robot-Use
summary: Multimodal agents (MMAs) sustain interaction through reasoning, memory, tools, and feedback, most visibly as computer-use agents, while robotic systems (RSs) couple sensing and actuation under physical dynamics. We define multimodal embodied agents (MMEAs) as goal-directed systems that couple multimodal task reasoning with physical action and revise decisions from the resulting feedback. This raises a central question: what changes when a multimodal agent moves from computer-use to robot-use? We introduce PAPAV, a unified capability-centric framework of five recurring functions: Perceive the current state, Anticipate action effects, Plan a feasible course, Act through an interface or body, and Verify the outcome. Defined by function rather than architecture, these capabilities let PAPAV identify what all three share and then compare MMEAs with MMAs and with RSs. Five physical constraints, from partial observability to unverifiable outcomes, leave fewer choices fixed in advance and less room to reverse errors. Across 64 benchmarks, explicit evaluation centers on Act; only 5 assess Anticipate and 3 assess Verify, leaving both largely hidden behind task success. These constraints also frame the open challenges we identify. PAPAV therefore provides a common basis for designing reliable physical agents and measuring progress across all five capabilities rather than task success alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了PAPAV统一能力框架，用于分析和比较多模态具身智能体(MMEAs)、多模态智能体(MMAs)及机器人系统(RSs)，揭示了从计算机使用到机器人使用转变时的核心变化与挑战。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决多模态智能体从计算机使用转向机器人使用时面临的变化问题，以及现有基准测试仅关注任务成功而忽略感知、预期、验证等核心能力评估的局限性。
AI.method: 提出了PAPAV框架，以功能而非架构为中心，定义了感知当前状态、预期动作效果、规划可行路线、执行动作和验证结果五个核心功能，用于比较不同智能体系统并分析物理约束。
AI.result: 在64个基准测试中发现，现有的显式评估主要集中在执行能力上，仅有5个评估预期、3个评估验证，且物理约束（如部分可观测性、不可验证结果）导致错误难以逆转且选择受限。
AI.conclusion: PAPAV为设计可靠的物理智能体提供了通用基础，强调未来应全面衡量这五项能力的进展，而不仅仅是依赖任务成功率，同时也为识别开放性挑战提供了框架。

title: Asymmetric On-Policy Distillation Learns In-Context Exploration
summary: Sequential decision-making under partial observability is difficult because agents must explore to infer hidden, task-relevant information before acting effectively. Learning such information-gathering behaviors tabula rasa via online reinforcement learning is sample-inefficient, whereas offline imitation averages expert actions across hidden states and fails to learn exploration. In this work, we propose ASTEROID, a simple and effective student--teacher supervised learning framework that can learn test-time exploration. Although a privileged expert never needs to explore, we demonstrate that a history-conditioned student can learn to do so when trained with on-policy contexts: the student first collects on-policy context under partial observability, and the privileged expert provides action labels conditioned on that context. By distilling expert actions directly conditioned on the student's on-policy history, the student learns to systematically resolve partial observability, i.e., search while uncertain and exploit once the hidden state is revealed. This enables efficient test-time exploration (similar to Bayesian posterior sampling) without incurring the impractical training-data costs of reinforcement learning. Across a diverse range of eleven different environments, including discrete exploration benchmarks, robotic manipulation, navigation, and Procgen environments, ASTEROID achieves ~2x higher returns under fixed exploration budgets, uses ~100x fewer interactions than RL baselines, and outperforms frontier models at exploration. Finally, our method transfers policies trained in simulation to vision-denied real-world robot manipulation, exhibiting efficient exploration and increasing success by +40% over standard distillation. Overall, it provides a simple yet surprisingly effective framework to learn efficient test-time exploration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ASTEROID，一种基于师生监督学习的框架，通过蒸馏基于学生在线历史的专家动作，使智能体能够高效学习测试时探索，并在多种环境中显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 部分可观测性下的序贯决策要求智能体在行动前探索隐藏信息。传统在线强化学习样本效率低下，而离线模仿学习在隐藏状态上平均专家动作，无法学习探索策略。
AI.method: 提出ASTEROID师生监督学习框架。学生模型首先在部分可观测下收集在线策略上下文（历史），特权专家模型则基于该上下文提供动作标签进行直接蒸馏，使学生在不确定时搜索并在状态揭示后利用。
AI.result: 在11个不同环境（包括离散探索、机器人操作、导航和Procgen）中，ASTEROID在固定探索预算下实现约2倍的高回报，交互次数比RL基线少约100倍，并优于前沿模型；在视觉缺失的真实机器人操作中，成功率比标准蒸馏提高40%。
AI.conclusion: ASTEROID为解决部分可观测性下的测试时探索提供了一种简单且高效的框架，无需强化学习的高昂数据成本即可实现类似贝叶斯后验采样的效果，并能有效迁移至真实世界。

title: Did the Problem Actually Get Harder? Testing LLMs on Paired P and NP-Complete Problems Hardened by Adversarial Multi-Agent Rewriting
summary: Many NP-complete (NPC) problems have a polynomial-time (P) twin that differs in a single structural detail, such as 3- versus 2-colouring a graph. A model that reasons rather than recalls should notice which side of this boundary a problem falls on, yet existing benchmarks either fix the wording of each task or ignore its complexity class, so they cannot separate the two. We introduce P2NPCBench, a benchmark of 12 problem families in which every NPC problem is paired with a P twin posed over the same surface. To remove the textbook cues that enable recall, we build it with AgentGAN, an adversarial multi-agent framework in which a generator rewrites each statement until a panel of frozen code models fails, while an executable validity gate keeps every rewrite answer- and class-preserving. The result is 2,114 hardened statements with hand-verified reference human solvers. Evaluating 12 proprietary and open-source models, we find that every model scores lower on NPC statements than on their P twins (35.4% vs. 63.8% pass@1), and that 95.1% of model-family pairs fail more often on the NPC side. A tenfold time limit raises NPC accuracy only from 28.5% to 31.9%, so failures stem from wrong or crashing programs rather than slow ones. Hardening also narrows the class gap from 24.8 to 14.6 points, showing that part of the apparent gap reflects familiarity with textbook phrasing rather than complexity class.

AI.tldr: 本文提出P2NPCBench基准，通过将NP完全问题与其多项式时间(P)孪生问题配对，评估大模型的真实推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基准无法区分模型是在进行真正的推理还是仅依赖对教科书式表述的记忆，且未考虑问题的复杂度类别。
AI.method: 构建P2NPCBench基准，利用AgentGAN对抗性多智能体框架重写问题陈述以消除教科书线索，并保证问题的答案和复杂度类别不变。
AI.result: 在12个模型的评估中，所有模型在NPC问题上的准确率均低于其P孪生问题（35.4% vs 63.8%）。增加时间限制仅略微提升NPC准确率，而经过强化重写后，类别间的性能差距从24.8缩小至14.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 模型在NPC问题上的失败主要源于程序错误或崩溃，而非运行超时。部分性能差距源于对教科书式表述的熟悉度，而非复杂度类别本身。

title: ProactEgoMem: Benchmarking Proactive Memory in Streaming Egocentric Video
summary: Today's multimodal assistants are typically prompted to interpret the visual evidence presented to them. To offload the cognitive burden of remembering across long horizons, wearable assistants should instead proactively acquire and maintain useful memory as the user's surroundings evolve. Doing so on the user's behalf requires identifying what matters, understanding the scene in real time, and initiating memory maintenance in the background while the user stays focused on their activities. We introduce ProactEgoMem, a benchmark that evaluates proactive memory in streaming egocentric video. Three tasks ground the evaluation in ambient environmental needs: Information Capture (IC) preserves transient yet dense visual information, State Tracking (ST) follows changing object states, and Location Tracking (LT) records object movements. The benchmark defines its protocol at two levels of proactiveness: the Notification Level asks for a single timely notification that satisfies the user's intent, while the deeper Intervention Level asks the agent to maintain memory on the user's behalf through an active start-to-stop tool lifecycle. Parallel ProactEgoMem-Daily and ProactEgoMem-Sci tracks contain 300/100 clips covering daily and scientific use cases, paired with 1000/500 questions in ProactEgoMem-QA, which measures the quality of the proactively acquired memory. Across proprietary, open-source, video-language, and streaming baselines, even the strongest models fail to capture memory both timely and accurately. ProactEgoMem provides a rigorous evaluation foundation for proactive multimodal assistance and for video agents that co-exist with their users.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ProactEgoMem基准，用于评估流式第一人称视频中的主动记忆能力，以减轻用户的认知负担。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴助手需要主动获取和维护有用的记忆以减轻用户长期的认知负担，从而使用户能专注于自身活动而无需手动提示。
AI.method: 提出了ProactEgoMem基准，通过信息捕获、状态跟踪和位置跟踪三个任务，在通知和干预两个层级评估流式第一人称视频中的主动记忆，并包含日常和科学场景的片段及问答集。
AI.result: 对多种专有、开源、视频语言和流式基线模型进行评估，发现即使是表现最好的模型也无法及时且准确地捕获记忆。
AI.conclusion: ProactEgoMem为主动多模态助手和与用户共存的视频智能体提供了严谨的评估基础。

title: GRAFT: Restoring the Missing Sampling Interface in Continuous Diffusion Language Models
summary: Continuous diffusion language models generate a whole sequence in parallel, never drawing a single word at any intermediate step; only the final step turns embeddings into text. Models such as ELF now report autoregressive-level quality at a fraction of the sampling steps of discrete-token diffusion models, and this design principle -- no step-wise discretization -- is what their own ablations credit for the gain. We show that this same principle carries a hidden cost: a collapse of the lexical long tail. Measured against held-out human text, ELF's output matches the human rate on common words almost exactly, yet its rarest words appear at only 0.30x the human rate, a gap that does not close from 105M to 652M parameters and that no sampler setting these models expose can reach. A same-size GPT-2, in contrast, spans zero to above the human rate by its decoding rule alone. We trace the difference to what continuous diffusion models lack: with no step that ever draws a discrete word, every step is instead driven by an average over the candidates still in play, and averaging a rare candidate together with the common word competing for its slot lands on the common word. An autoregressive model avoids this because its decoding rule samples one candidate rather than averaging over all of them. We propose GRAFT, a training-free method that grafts this missing choice back onto a frozen model: while the model is still undecided, GRAFT commits the rare words the average would otherwise discard, then regenerates the sequence from scratch with those commitments held in place. Across three ELF scales and on LangFlow, an independent continuous dLLM, GRAFT restores the rare-word share of generated text from 0.42-0.77x the human rate to 0.82-1.10x, a relative gain of 34-109%, and moves the entire word-frequency profile closer to human on every model tested, by 2.7x on ELF-B and 12x on LangFlow.

AI.tldr: 连续扩散语言模型在生成过程中因平均化操作导致稀有词生成率过低，本文提出了无需训练的GRAFT方法来恢复稀有词比例至人类水平。
AI.motivation: 连续扩散语言模型（如ELF）由于在中间步骤不生成离散词而是对候选词进行平均，导致词法长尾坍塌，稀有词出现率远低于人类水平，且该问题无法通过增加参数或调整采样器设置来解决。
AI.method: 提出了一种无需训练的方法GRAFT。在模型尚未决定时，GRAFT会提前锁定那些在平均化操作中会被丢弃的稀有词，然后带着这些约束从头重新生成序列。
AI.result: 在三个ELF规模和独立的LangFlow模型上，GRAFT将生成文本中的稀有词占比从人类水平的0.42-0.77倍恢复至0.82-1.10倍（相对提升34-109%），并在所有测试模型上将整体词频分布拉近至人类水平（ELF-B上提升2.7倍，LangFlow上提升12倍）。
AI.conclusion: GRAFT有效地弥补了连续扩散语言模型缺乏离散选择步骤的缺陷，无需额外训练即可显著改善其词频分布，使其更接近人类文本。

title: DiffResearch: Accelerating Deep Research with Diffusion Language Models
summary: Deep research systems iteratively plan, gather evidence, synthesize, and revise, making end-to-end latency a key bottleneck for interactive use. Almost all production systems are built on autoregressive (AR) language models and inherit left-to-right decoding in planning and long-form writing. We present DiffResearch, an open multi-agent deep research framework that places a diffusion language model (dLLM) at the core of every stage, and measure how a diffusion backbone changes latency and report quality. Holding the agentic scaffold, retrieval code, prompts, and evaluation fixed, we swap the backbone between an open diffusion model and a comparable AR model. Across 100 Deep Research Bench tasks, the diffusion backbone is roughly 6 times faster end-to-end, driven by order-of-magnitude reductions in planning and writing. We further introduce dFast, a decomposition mode that reads intermediate denoising states and extracts subqueries before generation finishes, providing a 1.99 times median speedup for decomposition in isolation with no loss of report quality. On the benchmark's RACE rubric, dFast obtains the best overall score among the three configurations. Finally, in a public system-level leaderboard snapshot, an instance built on a stronger diffusion model ranks above several commercial systems. We release DiffResearch under an Apache-2.0 license.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DiffResearch，一个在各个阶段核心采用扩散语言模型的多智能体深度研究框架，大幅降低了端到端延迟。
AI.motivation: 深度研究系统在规划、收集证据、综合和修订的迭代过程中，端到端延迟是交互式使用的主要瓶颈。现有系统大多基于自回归语言模型，继承了从左到右解码的局限性，亟需解决由此带来的延迟问题。
AI.method: 提出DiffResearch框架，在每个阶段核心使用扩散语言模型，并在固定智能体支架等条件下与自回归模型进行对比。同时引入dFast分解模式，通过在生成完成前读取中间去噪状态来提取子查询。
AI.result: 在100个Deep Research Bench任务中，扩散骨干端到端速度快约6倍。dFast在单独分解上提供1.99倍中位加速且无报告质量损失，并在RACE评分表中获得最佳总分。基于更强扩散模型的实例在公共系统级排行榜中排名高于多个商业系统。
AI.conclusion: 使用扩散语言模型作为骨干能有效解决深度研究系统中的延迟瓶颈，提升整体速度和质量。DiffResearch已以Apache-2.0许可证开源。

title: TeCoP: Accelerating Diffusion Large Language Model Decoding via Tentative Context Pipelining
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) predict multiple token positions per forward pass, yet block-wise decoders serialize generation and repeatedly recompute stable predictions. We attribute this inefficiency to coupling a prediction's readiness for irreversible commitment with its utility as context. We introduce Tentative Context Pipelining (TeCoP), a training-free decoder that decouples these roles through staggered block-parallel pipelining and draft-and-verify. TeCoP reuses stable but uncommitted predictions as provisional cross-block context, with commitment governed by confidence and stability checks. Across four LLaDA and Dream dLLMs on GSM8K, Minerva MATH, and MBPP, TeCoP reduces number of forward evaluations by up to 87% and achieves up to 7.50-fold throughput without KV caching and 11.77-fold with caching over the uncached original decoder. It outperforms Fast-dLLM and DSB in throughput across all 12 model-benchmark settings, with and without caching, while keeping average cached accuracy within one percentage point of the original decoder.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需训练的解码器TeCoP，通过解耦预测的提交与上下文重用，显著提升了扩散大语言模型的推理吞吐量并降低了计算开销。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型在逐块解码时存在序列化生成和重复计算稳定预测的低效问题，原因在于将预测的不可逆提交准备度与其作为上下文的效用耦合在一起。
AI.method: 提出试探性上下文流水线方法，这是一种无需训练的解码器。它通过交错的块并行流水线和草稿验证机制解耦上述角色，将稳定但未提交的预测作为临时的跨块上下文重用，并根据置信度和稳定性检查来决定是否提交。
AI.result: 在四个LLaDA和Dream模型及GSM8K等基准上的实验表明，TeCoP将前向评估次数减少了高达87%，在无KV缓存时实现最高7.50倍吞吐量提升，有缓存时提升达11.77倍。该方法在所有12种设置下的吞吐量均优于Fast-dLLM和DSB，且平均准确率与原始解码器保持在1个百分点以内。
AI.conclusion: TeCoP成功解决了dLLMs解码过程中的计算冗余问题，在几乎不损失精度的前提下大幅提升了推理效率，为扩散大语言模型的高效生成提供了新方向。

title: Who Gets Unmasked? Sampler-Induced Bias in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate by gradually unmasking a canvas, so their samplers decide not only which token to write but also when to commit it. We show that this second decision changes who appears in generated text, a sampler-induced bias on top of the model's own. Common commit rules, including LLaDA's default, commit the positions whose sampled tokens are most probable; this peeking favors majority options. To separate the sampler from the model, we read the model's belief about a fork, such as a protagonist's gender, in one forward pass, and show that this belief matches exact sampling from the model. Measured against it, peeking samplers on LLaDA and Dream amplify occupational gender stereotypes and collapse opinion distributions, and confidence-based ordering shifts gender-balanced occupations toward men, more so under faster parallel decoding. We propose Fork-First Sampling, which decides the fork before anything else is written: it follows the belief or any target distribution, improves fluency, and avoids the stories that remark on the protagonist's gender, which prompt-based fixes produce, at the cost of one forward pass. Fairness evaluations of dLLMs should report the commit rule.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了扩散语言模型采样器的提交规则会引入偏见，并提出Fork-First Sampling方法通过优先决定关键分歧点来消除该偏见。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型的采样器在决定令牌提交时机时会产生偏向多数派的偏见（如放大职业性别刻板印象、导致意见分布坍塌）。这一采样器诱导的偏见叠加在模型自身的偏见之上，亟需将二者分离并加以解决。
AI.method: 提出Fork-First Sampling方法。该方法在写入任何其他令牌之前，通过单次前向传播读取模型对关键分歧点（如主角性别）的真实信念，并据此或遵循目标分布优先决定分歧点。
AI.result: 实验表明，常见的基于置信度或“窥视”的提交规则在LLaDA和Dream模型上放大了性别刻板印象并导致意见分布坍塌；而Fork-First Sampling有效提高了流畅性，避免了提示词修复产生的性别提及问题，且仅增加一次前向传播开销。
AI.conclusion: 对扩散语言模型的公平性评估应报告其采样提交规则；Fork-First Sampling为缓解采样器诱导的偏见提供了有效且低成本的解决方案。

title: PV-Decoding: Progressive Verification Decoding with Decode Gating for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) offer an attractive alternative to autoregressive generation by updating multiple tokens in parallel, but their inference efficiency is still limited by the cost of safely committing tentative predictions. In particular, speculative decoding for dLLMs is challenging because speculative tokens within the same diffusion block may depend on one another, making aggressive acceptance prone to error propagation and strict verification computationally expensive. We present PV-Decoding, a confidence-driven speculative decoding framework with progressive verification for block diffusion inference. PV-Decoding partitions masked positions into directly decoded tokens, speculative tokens, and unresolved tokens using two confidence thresholds, and then verifies speculative tokens with progressively stronger policies, including single-batch, dual-batch, and multi-batch verification. This design exposes a practical accuracy--efficiency trade-off: weaker verification minimizes overhead, whereas stronger verification improves acceptance precision and robustness. Experiments on three diffusion language models across GSM8K, MBPP, and HumanEval show that PV-Decoding reduces sequential model forward passes (MFPs) by 8%--37% relative to confidence-based decoding, while keeping the largest observed accuracy drop to 1.3%. On Dream-7B-Instruct/GSM8K, PV-Decoding (1-batch) and PV-Decoding (2-batch) improve throughput by 7.0%--13.6% under the same hardware budget, whereas PV-Decoding (multi-batch) is slower under the current runtime. These results suggest that confidence-guided speculation with structured verification is a practical path toward efficient and reliable dLLM inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了PV-Decoding，一个用于离散扩散语言模型推理的置信度驱动投机解码框架，通过渐进式验证在准确性和效率之间取得了平衡。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散语言模型虽然能并行更新多个token，但推理效率受限于安全提交预测的成本。由于同一扩散块内的投机token可能相互依赖，激进的接受容易导致错误传播，而严格的验证计算成本高昂。
AI.method: PV-Decoding利用两个置信度阈值将掩码位置划分为直接解码token、投机token和未解决token，并通过单批次、双批次和多批次等渐进式更强的策略来验证投机token。
AI.result: 在三个扩散模型及GSM8K、MBPP和HumanEval数据集上的实验表明，相较于基于置信度的解码，PV-Decoding将顺序模型前向传递（MFPs）减少了8%至37%，且最大准确率下降仅为1.3%。在Dream-7B-Instruct/GSM8K上，1批次和2批次在相同硬件预算下将吞吐量提升了7.0%至13.6%，而多批次在当前运行时下较慢。
AI.conclusion: 结合结构化验证的置信度引导投机解码，是实现高效且可靠的离散扩散语言模型推理的实用途径。

title: DiffuPlan: Editable Planning State for Diffusion Language Model Agents
summary: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) are emerging as an alternative to autoregressive (AR) language models, yet dLLM agents largely inherit an interaction protocol designed for AR generation: once intermediate state is written, later observations can only be incorporated by appending more text. This is a poor match to a defining capability of dLLMs -- reconstructing earlier text conditioned on context that appears both before and after it. We ask whether this capability can support a different agent-state paradigm in which intermediate planning state is directly revisable as evidence arrives. We introduce DiffuPlan, a diffusion search agent that maintains a single editable planning state and reconstructs only the affected steps when later evidence resolves an entity or changes the search route. To support variable-length revisions, we introduce Expansion-Partition Marginalization (EPM), which marginalizes over equivalent expansion paths. We further adapt diffusion trajectory RL to multi-turn search. Across four multi-hop QA benchmarks, DiffuPlan achieves 50.24 average F1, outperforming strong AR search agents. More importantly, under identical data and training, editable planning state improves the diffusion agent by 2.44 F1 versus only 0.47 for its AR source model. These results show that dLLMs need not imitate append-only AR agents: revising committed state is a distinct agentic advantage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DiffuPlan，一个能够直接修改中间规划状态的扩散搜索智能体，证明了可编辑规划状态是扩散语言模型相比于自回归模型的独特优势。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型智能体通常继承自回归模型仅能追加文本的交互协议，未能利用扩散模型在前后文条件下重建先前文本的能力。本文旨在解决这一问题，探索一种可随新证据直接修改中间规划状态的新范式。
AI.method: 提出DiffuPlan，维持一个可编辑的规划状态，并在新证据出现时仅重建受影响的步骤；引入了Expansion-Partition Marginalization (EPM)以支持变长修改，并将扩散轨迹强化学习适应于多轮搜索。
AI.result: 在四个多跳问答基准上，DiffuPlan取得了50.24的平均F1分数，优于强大的自回归搜索智能体。在相同数据和训练下，可编辑规划状态使扩散智能体的F1提升了2.44，而其AR源模型仅提升0.47。
AI.conclusion: 扩散语言模型无需模仿仅能追加文本的自回归智能体，直接修改已确定的规划状态是其独特的智能体优势。

title: LED: Improving Masked Diffusion Language Models by Lookahead Editing
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive language models, enabling non-autoregressive text generation through parallel decoding. Existing dLLMs can be broadly categorized into two families: masked diffusion models (MDMs) and uniform diffusion models (UDMs) In this work, we theoretically show that MDMs are easier to optimize due to their mask-based transition schedule but have lower computational expressivity, whereas UDMs enable iterative state revision and greater expressivity but are substantially harder to train. This trade-off raises a natural question: can we obtain the expressivity of iterative revision without giving up the simple, easy-to-optimize transition schedule of MDMs? Motivated by this analysis, we propose Lookahead Editing (\ours{}), which augments masked diffusion decoding with a rewritable proposal state. At each decoding step, the model performs several lookahead updates to iteratively refine future predictions in this proposal state before committing tokens to the masked sequence. This design introduces a rewritable proposal that uses additional compute to improve expressivity while keeping the simple mask-based transition schedule of MDMs. We fine-tune Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen3-8B to obtain LED-\texttt{7B} and LED-\texttt{8B}, respectively. Across eight benchmarks, LED SFT yields average gains of $+11.4$ and $+7.7$ points over standard MDM SFT. Moreover, using SFT alone, LED-\texttt{8B} outperforms LLaDA2.1-16B Q-mode, which is trained with continued pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 提出前瞻编辑（LED）方法，通过引入可重写的提案状态，在不牺牲掩码扩散模型易优化性的前提下提升其计算表达力。
AI.motivation: 解决掩码扩散模型（MDMs）计算表达力低与均匀扩散模型（UDMs）难以训练之间的权衡问题。
AI.method: 在掩码扩散解码中引入可重写的提案状态，通过多次前瞻更新迭代优化未来预测，再将令牌提交至掩码序列。
AI.result: LED-7B和LED-8B在八个基准测试中相比标准MDM平均提升11.4和7.7分，仅使用SFT即超越多阶段训练的LLaDA2.1-16B。
AI.conclusion: 结合可重写提案状态的掩码扩散解码能以额外计算成本换取更高的表达力，且保持易优化性，显著提升了扩散大语言模型的性能。

title: On the SPOT: Enhancing Speculative Decoding for Diffusion Language Models via Commit-Order Prediction
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) promise parallel text generation, but in practice face an unresolved speed-quality trade-off. Exact decoding fills in only one masked position per model pass, while faster multi-token decoding schemes are lossy. Speculative decoding is the standard lossless acceleration for autoregressive models. However, it does not transfer directly to DLMs, which must choose both what to generate and where. We show that this order is the missing piece: the model's own predictions from the previous pass already give the right token at 92-100% of positions, but not which position comes next. Based on this observation, we introduce Speculating Positions Order Trajectory (SPOT), which learns to predict this order. A 0.62M-parameter model reads only the target's output distributions and proposes a tree of candidate continuations, and the target verifies all of them in a single pass by checking whether each equals its own next state. On the verification side, our analysis shows that prior block-diffusion verification approaches either assume $T=0$ or a sequential proposal interface. To support tree-based speculation at any temperature, we propose using coupled-noise match verification for diffusion blocks, following shared-Gumbel-noise coupling approaches. Our comprehensive experiments show that SPOT cuts target passes by up to 6.8x and reaches up to 3.2x the throughput of standard decoding, beating the calibrated and training-free drafting baselines in every task and budget at $T=0$ and $T=1$. In addition, we show that the learned drafter transfers across models, demonstrating successful transfer across six different DLMs. Project page: https://eliezer318.github.io/SPOT-dLLM/

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPOT方法，通过学习预测扩散语言模型中掩码位置的填充顺序，实现无损的并行投机解码加速。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLMs）虽然承诺并行文本生成，但面临速度-质量权衡：精确解码每次只填充一个位置速度慢，而多token解码有损失。标准投机解码无法直接迁移到DLMs，因为DLMs需要同时决定生成什么内容以及在哪里生成，而现有方法缺少对位置顺序的预测。
AI.method: 提出Speculating Positions Order Trajectory (SPOT)：一个仅0.62M参数的小模型读取目标模型的输出分布，预测位置填充顺序并提议候选续写的树状结构；目标模型在单次前向传递中验证所有候选。在验证方面，提出coupled-noise match verification支持任意温度下的树形投机解码。
AI.result: SPOT将目标模型前向传递次数减少最多6.8倍，吞吐量达到标准解码的3.2倍，在T=0和T=1条件下所有任务和预算设置中均优于校准和无训练草稿基线。此外，学习的草稿器成功跨六个不同DLMs迁移。
AI.conclusion: 位置顺序预测是DLMs投机解码的缺失关键环节。SPOT通过轻量级模型预测位置顺序并结合耦合噪声验证，实现了DLMs的无损加速，且具有良好的跨模型迁移能力。

title: Rethinking User Encoders: Routing Diffusion States for Scenario-Adaptive User Representation
summary: Existing large language model (LLM)-based user encoders serialize heterogeneous behavioral logs and compress them into static representations through autoregressive (AR) prediction. However, their unidirectional constraint limits bidirectional information flow, hindering cross-modal interactions and the joint preservation of multi-source signals. Consequently, the learned static representations struggle to accommodate the distinct evidence requirements of diverse downstream scenarios. We address these limitations by unlocking the iterative denoising process of diffusion language models (dLLMs) as a multi-granularity reconstruction space. Based on this insight, we propose FINDERS (FactorIzatioN of Diffusion statEs for Routing across Scenarios), a router-equipped dLLM framework comprising four operations: denoise, factorize, route, and compress. Learnable meta-slots organize complementary denoising states into transferable cross-modal semantics and modality-specific behavioral factors. To provide grounded supervision, we construct BehaviorQA, a large-scale corpus containing explicit behavioral rationales. Guided by scenario queries, a lightweight router dynamically emphasizes relevant slot directions via an input-level residual pathway before cross-source fusion and final compression. Extensive experiments and online A/B tests across ten industrial scenarios demonstrate that FINDERS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both unified and scenario-adaptive settings. This work effectively pushes the boundaries of dLLMs beyond language generation, demonstrating their immense potential as powerful user representation learners.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了基于扩散语言模型的路由框架FINDERS，通过多粒度去噪状态重构和动态路由机制，解决了现有LLM用户编码器静态表示难以适应多场景需求的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于LLM的用户编码器使用自回归预测将行为日志压缩为静态表示，单向约束限制了双向信息流和多源信号的联合保存，导致静态表示无法适应多样化下游场景的证据需求。
AI.method: 提出FINDERS框架，解锁扩散语言模型的迭代去噪过程作为多粒度重构空间。该框架包含去噪、因子分解、路由和压缩四个操作，利用可学习的元槽组织去噪状态，并通过轻量级路由器在场景查询引导下动态强调相关槽方向，同时引入BehaviorQA语料库提供监督。
AI.result: 在十个工业场景的广泛实验和在线A/B测试表明，FINDERS在统一和场景自适应设置中均显著优于现有最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: 本研究成功将扩散语言模型的应用边界扩展到语言生成之外，证明了其作为强大用户表示学习器的巨大潜力。

title: Energy Consumption Analysis of Discrete Diffusion and Autoregressive Language Models
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) continue to scale, their energy consumption during inference has become a critical concern. While Autoregressive (AR) models are the industry standard, Diffusion Language Models (DLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative capable of parallel token generation. In this paper, we perform a comparative energy benchmark of diffusion models (LLaDA-8B, Dream-7B) against AR counterparts (Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5-7B). We analyze the trade-offs between model architecture, KV-cache optimization, and Joules-per-token efficiency. Our results show that at longer sequences (200--600 tokens), diffusion models achieve 2.5--2.7 J/token, approximately 2$\times$ more efficient than AR models with KV-cache (5.3--5.7 J/token). KV-cache provides substantial benefits for AR models at longer sequences (50--70\% energy reduction).

AI.tldr: 本文比较了扩散语言模型与自回归模型在推理时的能耗效率，发现长序列下扩散模型的能效约为自回归模型的两倍。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型规模的扩大，其推理过程中的能耗问题成为关键关切。本文旨在解决不同模型架构在能耗效率上的权衡问题。
AI.method: 对比扩散模型（LLaDA-8B, Dream-7B）与自回归模型（Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5-7B）的能耗，分析模型架构、KV-cache优化与每Token焦耳能耗之间的权衡。
AI.result: 在长序列（200-600 tokens）下，扩散模型达到2.5-2.7 J/token的能耗，比带KV缓存的AR模型（5.3-5.7 J/token）效率高约2倍。KV缓存为AR模型在长序列下减少了50-70%的能耗。
AI.conclusion: 扩散语言模型在长序列生成的能耗效率上显著优于传统的自回归模型，且KV缓存对降低AR模型长序列能耗具有重要作用。

title: Where Draft Trees Lose Target Mass: Exit-Guided Speculative Decoding
summary: Tree-based speculative decoding verifies multiple draft continuations in one target-model pass, but finite trees built from draft scores face a fundamental draft-target mismatch. We ask whether better exact verification can increase acceptance on a fixed tree and how target feedback can improve the tree itself. Through a target-flow view, we identify a canonical exit law and prove that one plus target coverage sharply bounds the expected output-block length, including the bonus token, of any exact path verifier. All optimal verifiers share the same exit and bonus-token law, already attained by representative predraw-and-follow and sequential residual verifiers. This yields Tree Exit Verification (TEV), an exact, level-parallel procedure using one exit-node decision and one bonus-token decision. The exit law also identifies missing target probability, providing node-level feedback for Exit-Guided Draft-Tree Training (ExitTrain) on inference-time draft trees. Experiments across dialogue, code, and mathematical reasoning validate fixed-tree equivalence: ExitTrain increases average output-block length by 13%, while TEV reduces verifier-stage latency by 15%, yielding a 14% end-to-end speedup over DDTree. Our results distinguish two opportunities: better draft trees for higher acceptance and more direct verification for lower latency. Code: https://github.com/hsj576/TEV.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了树退出验证（TEV）和退出引导草稿树训练（ExitTrain），分别通过更直接的验证和目标反馈来优化基于树的推测解码。
AI.motivation: 基于树的推测解码中，由草稿分数构建的有限树面临草稿模型与目标模型不匹配的根本问题。本文旨在解决如何在固定树上通过精确验证提高接受率，以及如何利用目标反馈改进树结构本身。
AI.method: 通过目标流视图识别出规范退出定律，证明最优验证器共享相同的退出和奖励令牌定律。据此提出TEV，一种精确的层级并行验证程序，仅需一次退出节点决策和一次奖励令牌决策；并利用缺失的目标概率提出ExitTrain，为推理时的草稿树提供节点级反馈。
AI.result: 在对话、代码和数学推理任务上的实验表明，ExitTrain将平均输出块长度增加了13%，而TEV将验证阶段延迟降低了15%，相比DDTree实现了14%的端到端加速。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果明确指出了两个优化机会：构建更好的草稿树以提高接受率，以及采用更直接的验证方法以降低延迟。

title: DominoTree: Conditional Tree-Structured Drafting with Domino for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding speeds up large language model inference: a small drafter proposes several tokens, and the target model verifies them in one parallel pass. Drafting a tree lets the target verify many alternative continuations at once. DDTree builds such trees from the block-diffusion drafter DFlash, but scores each position independently of the tokens earlier in its branch; Domino conditions on those tokens but drafts only a single chain. DominoTree combines the two: a training-free best-first tree scored by Domino's path-dependent causal correction, restricted to top-M candidates. In a research harness at temperature zero, it averages 5.33x speedup over autoregressive (AR) decoding on Qwen3-4B and 6.89x on Qwen3-8B, peaking at 8.77x; across temperatures it is 20-26% faster than Domino on Qwen3-4B and 27-36% on Qwen3-8B, and 11-20% faster than the stronger of DDTree and its cost-aware variant CaDDTree. A controlled decomposition attributes +10.1% (Qwen3-4B) and +10.7% (Qwen3-8B) accepted length to the correction, and +4.7% and +4.4% to conditioning on the realized path. Served in SGLang on one RTX 5090, it reaches 4.11x and 4.83x AR at batch size 1, 1.17x and 1.09x the speed of Domino's chain, and up to 1.71x AR on 8K-token HELMET summarization, 14-21% above the chain. The lead holds at 2 concurrent requests but reverses from 8 onward, where the chain sustains more goodput despite DominoTree's 28% higher acceptance. DominoTree accepts more tokens than the chain in every serving setting. On the hybrid Gated-DeltaNet Qwen3.6-27B, correct output requires tree-aware recurrent verification; with it, DominoTree matches the chain at batch size 1 (4.58x versus 4.54x AR) and reaches up to 2.11x AR at long context, 15% above the chain.

AI.tldr: DominoTree结合了DDTree的树形生成和Domino的路径依赖评分机制，无需额外训练即可显著提升大语言模型的推理速度。
AI.motivation: 现有的推测解码方法中，DDTree在构建树时未考虑路径依赖性，而Domino虽然能条件于路径但只能生成单链；本文旨在解决如何结合两者的优势以提高解码效率。
AI.method: 提出DominoTree，一种无需训练的最佳优先树结构，利用Domino的路径依赖因果校正进行评分，并限制为前M个候选词；同时为混合模型引入了树感知的循环验证机制。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B和8B模型上，相比自回归解码平均实现5.33倍和6.89倍的加速，且显著优于Domino和DDTree等方法；在RTX 5090上的SGLang部署中，单批次下达到4.11倍和4.83倍加速，长文本摘要任务上最高达1.71倍；在混合Gated-DeltaNet模型上，长文本场景下达到2.11倍加速。
AI.conclusion: DominoTree通过结合路径依赖评分和树形推测解码，在低批次和长上下文场景中实现了显著的推理加速，但在高并发批次下，单链方法的吞吐量表现更优。

title: GRAFT: Adaptive DLM-Based Draft Tree Construction with Target-Distilled Edge Scoring
summary: Tree-based speculative decoding raises the mean accepted tokens of standard speculative decoding by verifying multiple draft paths, and existing tree builders typically construct these paths through parent-conditioned expansion, where each child token is generated conditioned on its parent path. This construction is incompatible with diffusion language model (DLM) drafters such as DFlash, which produces all future-position distributions in a single forward pass. DDTree bridges this gap by treating high-probability tokens from each future-position distribution as candidate nodes and selecting edges between consecutive positions under a fixed node budget. However, its edge selection relies on token probability alone without modeling parent--child compatibility, so target-compatible tokens can be attached to wrong parents; moreover, its fixed budget ignores that the throughput-optimal tree size varies with the decoding state. We propose GRAFT, a draft-tree construction framework for DLM-based speculative decoding. GRAFT introduces Target-Distilled Edge Scoring (TDES), which distills parent--child preferences from target-model traces to select target-compatible edges, and State-Aware Budget Allocation (SABA), which sets the per-round tree budget by balancing expected draft gain against verification cost. Across multiple models and tasks, GRAFT achieves $2.13\times$--$6.36\times$ end-to-end speedup over autoregressive decoding while adding less than $0.5$\,ms of overhead per round, approximately $1.4\%$ of the target-model verification latency.

AI.tldr: 提出GRAFT框架，通过目标蒸馏边缘评分和状态感知预算分配，为基于扩散语言模型的投机解码构建草稿树。
AI.motivation: 现有的树构建方法不兼容扩散语言模型（DLM）草稿器，且现有DDTree方法仅依赖概率选择边缘导致父子节点不兼容，其固定预算也无法适应解码状态的变化。
AI.method: 提出GRAFT框架，包含目标蒸馏边缘评分（TDES）和状态感知预算分配（SABA）。TDES从目标模型轨迹中提取父子偏好以选择目标兼容的边缘；SABA通过平衡预期草稿增益与验证成本来动态设置每轮的树预算。
AI.result: 在多个模型和任务上，GRAFT相比自回归解码实现了2.13倍至6.36倍的端到端加速，且每轮额外开销不到0.5毫秒（约占目标模型验证延迟的1.4%）。
AI.conclusion: GRAFT有效解决了DLM草稿器在树状投机解码中的边缘选择与动态预算分配问题，在保持极低开销的同时实现了显著的推理加速。

title: Cost-Aware Diffusion Draft Trees for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates inference by having a lightweight drafter propose tokens verified in parallel by the target language model. Block diffusion drafters such as DFlash generate an entire draft block in one pass, yielding per-position marginals; DDTree uses these to build a candidate tree that maximizes expected acceptance length under a fixed node budget. We observe, however, that acceptance length is non-decreasing in budget: it always favors larger trees regardless of verification cost, offering no principled basis for budget selection. We introduce \textbf{CaDDTree} (Cost-aware Diffusion Draft Tree), a method that directly optimizes token throughput (expected tokens generated per unit time) by jointly selecting the tree structure and node budget. We model draft and verification latencies explicitly, show that the throughput objective decomposes into a per-round one-dimensional search over the budget, and prove that under a convex verification cost the throughput function is \emph{unimodal}, enabling an efficient greedy stopping rule. CaDDTree requires no offline budget search, adapting the budget each round from the current per-position distributions and verification cost. Experiments on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B across eight benchmarks spanning reasoning, coding, and instruction-following tasks show that \caDDTree{} matches or surpasses DDTree with oracle budget selection on nearly all tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CaDDTree方法，通过联合优化树结构和节点预算直接最大化Token吞吐量，解决了推测解码中预算选择缺乏原则性依据的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的块扩散起草器（如DDTree）最大化预期接受长度，但该指标随节点预算非递减，总是偏好更大的树而忽略验证成本，导致预算选择缺乏原则性依据。
AI.method: 提出CaDDTree，显式建模起草和验证延迟，将吞吐量目标转化为每轮对预算的一维搜索，并证明在凸验证成本下吞吐量函数为单峰，从而利用贪婪停止规则实现无离线搜索的动态预算自适应。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B上的8个基准测试（涵盖推理、编程和指令遵循）表明，CaDDTree在几乎所有任务上均匹配或超越使用先知预算的DDTree。
AI.conclusion: CaDDTree为推测解码提供了一种有原则且成本感知的树结构和节点预算优化方法，有效提升了推理吞吐量。

title: TAPS: Target-Aware Prefix Tree Selection for Diffusion-Drafted Speculative Decoding
summary: Using a diffusion model for parallel drafting is a promising approach for speculative decoding. By predicting tokens at multiple future positions in a single forward pass, diffusion drafters substantially reduce drafting latency. However, this shifts the bottleneck to verification: verifying a single sequence limits acceptance length, while verifying large draft trees incurs excessive target-model latency. We identify a key mismatch in existing draft-tree methods: existing diffusion-tree methods rank nodes by the marginal probability, ignoring that verification is prefix-conditioned. As a result, they may verify unreachable descendants of rejected prefixes, increasing latency with limited acceptance gains. To address this, we propose TAPS, a target-aware prefix selection method that turns diffusion marginals into path-conditioned acceptance estimates. TAPS then selects a compact prefix-closed subtree under a fixed verification budget, improving the acceptance-cost tradeoff rather than simply expanding the draft tree. Experiments across diverse datasets and model families demonstrate that TAPS achieves up to 7.9x lossless end-to-end speedup over vanilla autoregressive decoding, outperforming state-of-the-art DFlash and DDTree by 1.36x and 1.74x respectively. Our work is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TAPS-EMNLP2026-53DD

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TAPS方法，通过目标感知前缀选择优化扩散模型推测解码的验证瓶颈，实现了高达7.9倍的无损端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 使用扩散模型进行并行草拟虽然减少了草拟延迟，但瓶颈转移到了验证阶段。现有方法基于边缘概率对节点排序，忽略了验证的前缀条件性，导致验证被拒绝前缀的不可达后代，增加了验证延迟且接收增益有限。
AI.method: 提出TAPS（目标感知前缀选择）方法，将扩散边缘概率转化为路径条件化的接收估计，并在固定验证预算下选择紧凑的前缀闭合子树，以改善接收与成本的权衡。
AI.result: 在多种数据集和模型上的实验表明，TAPS相比原始自回归解码实现了最高7.9倍的无损端到端加速，且比当前最先进的DFlash和DDree分别快1.36倍和1.74倍。
AI.conclusion: TAPS通过优化前缀选择而非简单扩展草拟树，有效解决了扩散草拟中的验证瓶颈，实现了显著的无损加速，为推测解码提供了更高效的接收-成本权衡方案。

title: Accelerating Speculative Decoding with Block Diffusion Draft Trees
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive language models by using a lightweight drafter to propose multiple future tokens, which the target model then verifies in parallel. DFlash shows that a block diffusion drafter can generate an entire draft block in a single forward pass and achieve state-of-the-art speculative decoding performance, outperforming strong autoregressive drafters such as EAGLE-3. Vanilla DFlash, however, still verifies only a single drafted trajectory per round, potentially limiting its acceptance length. We introduce DDTree (Diffusion Draft Tree), a method that constructs a draft tree directly from the per-position distributions of a block diffusion drafter. Under a fixed node budget, DDTree uses a simple best-first heap algorithm to select the continuations that are most likely to match the target model according to a surrogate defined by the draft model's output. The resulting tree is verified efficiently in a single target model forward pass using an ancestor-only attention mask. Because DDTree builds on DFlash, a leading draft model for speculative decoding, these gains place DDTree among the leading approaches to speculative decoding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DDTree方法，通过从块扩散草稿模型的逐位置分布构建草稿树，提升投机解码的验证效率和接受长度。
AI.motivation: 现有的DFlash方法每轮仅验证单条草拟轨迹，可能限制其接受长度，因此需要一种能够利用块扩散模型分布生成多轨迹并进行高效验证的方法。
AI.method: DDTree直接从块扩散草稿模型的逐位置分布构建草稿树，在固定节点预算下使用最佳优先堆算法选择最可能匹配目标模型的续写，并采用仅祖先注意力掩码在单次目标模型前向传播中完成树结构验证。
AI.result: DDTree在DFlash的基础上取得了显著性能增益，成为目前领先的投机解码方法之一。
AI.conclusion: 通过构建草稿树克服了单轨迹验证的局限性，DDTree有效提升了基于块扩散的投机解码性能。

title: TARSphere: A Robot-Oriented Full-Stack Framework for Long-Horizon Embodied Agents in Evolving Physical and Social Environments
summary: Robots must act under physical and social constraints while adapting to changes in their environment and human needs. Existing embodied-agent systems often focus on specified goals or abstract execution into symbolic actions, limiting evaluation in an evolving world. We introduce TARSphere, a robot-oriented full-stack framework for physically and socially grounded long-horizon embodied agents. TARSphere-Infra runs robot policies in a physics simulator with embodied NPCs and constrained dialogue. An event-driven finite-state machine (FSM) uses completed actions and delivered information to update task states and evaluate outcomes. TARSphere-Harness, its embodied brain harness, lets a frozen multimodal large language model (MLLM) act through multi-level executable skills, using observations, hierarchical memory, and execution feedback to revise its decisions. On this foundation, agent-in-the-loop curation aligns task semantics, causal dependencies, and scene geometry to construct TARSphere-Bench: 360 episodes across 30 indoor scenes. Five paired conditions assess perceptual robustness, disruption adaptation, task update, human coordination, and intent understanding for navigate-and-report and fetch-and-deliver tasks. Our evaluation of 8 MLLMs shows that general-purpose models can outperform embodied models, while task updates and human interaction remain difficult. Frequent collisions and falls further motivate evaluating execution safety alongside task success, even with a shared action interface and decision budget.
comment: 13 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables. Project page: https://xuyicheng-zju.github.io/TARSphere/ Code: https://github.com/xuyicheng-zju/TARSphere

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TARSphere，一个面向物理与社会约束的长视野具身机器人的全栈框架及基准测试。
AI.motivation: 现有的具身智能体系统多关注特定目标或将执行抽象为符号动作，限制了对不断演化的环境的评估。机器人需要在物理与社会约束下行动，并适应环境变化和人类需求。
AI.method: 提出全栈框架TARSphere，包含TARSSphere-Infra（在物理模拟器中运行策略，利用事件驱动有限状态机更新和评估任务）与TARSphere-Harness（利用冻结的多模态大语言模型，结合多级可执行技能、分层记忆和执行反馈进行决策）。基于此构建了包含30个室内场景、360个测试片段的TARSphere-Bench，并设置了五种配对条件进行评估。

AI.conclusion: 通用模型在具身任务中展现出超越具身模型的潜力，但在动态任务更新和人机协作方面仍存在挑战；未来的具身智能体评估应将执行安全性与任务成功率置于同等重要的位置。

title: CausGround: Causal Interaction Grounding for Adaptive Embodied Planning
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) show promising reasoning capabilities, but reliable physical interaction requires planning that accounts for when actions are executable and how they change the world. These preconditions and effects are environment-dependent and often not captured by MLLMs, making adaptation challenging. Yet existing approaches either require costly environment-specific training or rely on unstructured interaction experience that is difficult to reuse. Therefore, we introduce CausGround, a non-parametric causal interaction grounding framework that distills interaction experience into reusable action-centered causal knowledge. CausGround identifies action preconditions and effects and organizes them in a factorized world-state representation capturing object attributes and inter-object relations. At planning time, task-relevant causal dependencies are grounded in current observations to support backward reasoning over preconditions and forward reasoning over effects for action selection and multi-step planning. We evaluate CausGround on simulated high-level planning, interaction reasoning, and real-world robot manipulation. On adapted VirtualHome and RoboCasa benchmarks, CausGround improves vision-based high-level planning across MLLM backbones, increasing average task success from 24.9% to 53.3% on VirtualHome and closed-loop planning success from 43.0% to 57.0% on RoboCasa. On SWITCH, average interaction reasoning accuracy increases from 25.8% to 31.9%, indicating improved action selection, recovery, and verification. Moreover, real-world experiments show that CausGround reasons backward from MLLM-interpreted goals to derive executable high-level action sequences for sequential manipulation. These results demonstrate that reusable action preconditions and effects support long-horizon embodied planning across diverse environments without parameter updates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出非参数化因果交互基础框架CausGround，通过提取可复用的动作前置条件和效果，无需参数更新即可支持跨环境的长周期具身规划。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在物理交互中难以捕捉依赖于环境的动作前置条件和效果，而现有适应方法要么需要昂贵的特定环境训练，要么依赖难以复用的非结构化交互经验。
AI.method: 提出非参数化因果交互基础框架CausGround，将交互经验提炼为可复用的以动作为中心的因果知识。该框架识别动作的前置条件和效果，并将其组织到捕捉对象属性和对象间关系的因子化世界状态表示中。在规划时，将任务相关的因果依赖关系落实到当前观察中，支持基于前置条件的逆向推理和基于效果的顺向推理，用于动作选择和多步规划。
AI.result: 在VirtualHome和RoboCasa基准上，CausGround显著提升了基于视觉的高层规划成功率，使VirtualHome的平均任务成功率从24.9%提高到53.3%，RoboCasa的闭环规划成功率从43.0%提高到57.0%。在SWITCH上，平均交互推理准确率从25.8%提高到31.9%。此外，真实世界实验表明CausGround能够从MLLM解释的目标逆向推理，为顺序操作生成可执行的高层动作序列。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，可复用的动作前置条件和效果无需参数更新即可支持跨不同环境的长周期具身规划。

title: Melange: A Synthetic Visual Bias Benchmark for Multi-modal Large Language Models
summary: Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have seen broad adoption, but their biases are still far less examined than those of standard LLMs, creating possible social harms when deployed in real-world settings. Prior efforts to extend bias analyses from LLMs into the multi-modal space either cover only a few bias categories or do not ensure that the groups being compared are clearly addressed by visual cues in the images. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Melange, a wide-ranging synthetic visual benchmark covering seven categories for assessing social biases in MLLMs. It is grounded in the widely used language-only BBQ dataset (Bias Benchmark for Question Answering) from BigBench, carefully extending its constructed contexts via controlled generation of visual scenarios so the target attributes appear visually and clearly. To maximize reliability, our generated images pass through two stages of validation: automated screening using visual question answering (VQA) and subsequent manual inspection by human annotators. By systematically evaluating 23 open-source MLLMs across three matched evaluation settings---text-only, image-only, and image-with-context---Melange isolates the fairness effect of the input modality. Switching from text to vision reduces fairness by 0.291 on average, a gap that varies by model family rather than by scale alone. A perception control confirms that this gap is not an artifact of visual comprehension: models identify the depicted attributes at 90--95\% accuracy yet still fail to abstain. When models do commit to a biased answer, polarity-aware stereotype alignment shows they choose the human-stereotypical response roughly three-quarters of the time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了多模态偏见评估基准Melange，发现从文本输入转向视觉输入会显著降低多模态大语言模型的公平性。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的偏见问题相较于标准LLMs较少被研究，在现实部署中可能造成社会危害；且现有研究仅覆盖少数偏见类别，或未确保视觉线索能清晰区分目标群体。
AI.method: 引入了基于纯文本BBQ数据集的合成视觉基准Melange，涵盖七个社会偏见类别；通过受控生成视觉场景并经VQA自动筛选和人工检查两阶段验证；在纯文本、纯图像和带上下文图像三种设置下评估了23个开源MLLMs。
AI.result: 从文本切换到视觉输入平均降低了0.291的公平性，此差距因模型家族而异而非规模；尽管模型识别属性的准确率高达90-95%，但未能弃权，且在做出偏见回答时约75%的情况选择符合人类刻板印象的响应。
AI.conclusion: Melange成功隔离了输入模态对公平性的影响，揭示了MLLMs在视觉输入下存在显著的公平性下降，尽管其视觉感知能力很强。

title: Balancing Foundation Models and Trait-Specific Learning for Forehead-Crease Recognition
summary: Biometric recognition often degrades under partial facial vis- ibility, where conventional facial cues are occluded. The forehead region remains consistently visible and contains distinctive crease patterns that can serve as a complementary biometric trait. We present a unified eval- uation of forehead-crease recognition across explainable zero-shot rea- soning, domain-adaptive learning, and trait-specific modeling. FIRE en- ables interpretable zero-shot verification using multimodal large language models, while pretrained face-recognition models are adapted to the fore- head domain through margin-based learning. Under open-set evaluation, the best zero-shot model GPT-4o+FIRE achieves 18.22% EER, while Edge-Forehead achieves 8.30% EER and 54.01% TMR@0.1% FMR. The results show that although MLLMs offer interpretable zero-shot verifi- cation, trait-specific learning remains more effective for robust forehead- crease biometric recognition.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了基于额头皱纹的生物识别方法，发现特定特征学习比多模态大模型的零样本验证更为有效和鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 传统面部生物识别在面部部分遮挡时性能下降，而额头区域通常保持可见且包含独特的皱纹图案，可作为互补的生物识别特征。
AI.method: 提出了一个统一的评估框架，包含使用多模态大语言模型进行可解释零样本验证的FIRE方法，以及通过基于边距的领域自适应学习将预训练人脸识别模型适应于额头区域的方法。
AI.result: 在开放集评估中，最佳零样本模型GPT-4o+FIRE的EER为18.22%，而特定特征模型Edge-Forehead的EER达到8.30%，且在0.1% FMR下的TMR达到54.01%。
AI.conclusion: 多模态大语言模型虽能提供可解释的零样本验证，但针对特定特征的学习方法在实现鲁棒的额头皱纹生物识别方面仍更为有效。

title: LLMSeg: Training-Free Text-Prompted Image Segmentation with B-Splines
summary: Promptable segmentation models such as SAM 3 achieve remarkable open-vocabulary performance but require dedicated architectures, large-scale annotation engines, and task-specific training. We ask a different question: can a general-purpose multimodal large language model (MLLM) segment images directly, without an added segmentation head, mask decoder, or training? We present LLMSeg, a training-free pipeline that turns a vision-capable LLM into a text-prompted image segmenter. LLMSeg decomposes segmentation into three LLM-driven stages. First, detect localizes all instances matching a free-form text query and describes their coarse morphology. Next, segment traces each instance using closed periodic B-splines confined to its detected box. These splines define an outer boundary and optional hole loops. Finally, refine iteratively proposes focus boxes around residual errors and retraces confined splines. The process ends when the mask stabilizes or the pass budget is exhausted. The output is a binary mask with inspectable intermediate geometry. We evaluate LLMSeg across ten referring and reasoning segmentation splits (ReasonSeg and RefCOCO/+/g). We also evaluate open-vocabulary instance segmentation (LVIS, COCO, and SA-Co), semantic segmentation, and zero-shot detection (ODinW13 and RF-100VL). With an off-the-shelf Gemini-3.7-Flash backend, LLMSeg is competitive with and often surpasses the specialist SAM 3 model on identical items. It reaches 71.5 cIoU on ReasonSeg val without additional segmentation-specific training. Backend model updates can improve accuracy without retraining the pipeline. The code is available at https://abdullahamdi.com/llmseg .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需训练的图像分割流水线LLMSeg，利用通用多模态大语言模型直接进行文本提示的图像分割，性能可与专门的SAM 3模型相媲美。
AI.motivation: 现有的可提示分割模型依赖专用架构、大规模标注引擎和特定任务训练。本文旨在解决这一问题，探讨通用多模态大语言模型能否在无需添加分割头、掩码解码器或进行训练的情况下直接进行图像分割。
AI.method: 提出LLMSeg，一个无需训练的流水线，包含三个由LLM驱动的阶段：1. 检测，定位匹配文本查询的实例并描述其粗略形态；2. 分割，使用限制在检测框内的闭合周期B样条追踪每个实例；3. 细化，迭代提出围绕残差误差的焦点框并重新追踪限制样条，直到掩码稳定或达到预算。
AI.result: 在多个数据集（ReasonSeg, RefCOCO/+/g, LVIS, COCO等）上的评估表明，使用现成的Gemini-3.7-Flash后端，LLMSeg在相同项目上具有竞争力，甚至经常超过专家SAM 3模型，在ReasonSeg验证集上达到71.5 cIoU。
AI.conclusion: 通用MLLM可以在无需专门训练的情况下实现强大的图像分割能力，且后端模型的更新无需重新训练流水线即可提高准确性。

title: LocalAgent: Collaborative Agentic Verification for Fine-Grained Instance-Level Consistency
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress in general visual understanding, yet they still struggle with fine-grained instance-level consistency verification, where the goal is to determine whether two images depict the exact same physical object under varying viewpoints, illumination, and backgrounds. This task requires both global semantic perception and precise examination of subtle local evidence, since semantically similar objects may differ only in small suspicious regions. To address this challenge, we propose LocalAgent, a collaborative agentic framework that integrates the complementary strengths of a generalist MLLM and lightweight specialist verifiers. The MLLM first reasons globally to identify suspicious local regions, which are then delegated to a Local Evidence Verifier (LEV) toolkit for fine-grained appearance and geometric matching. LEV comprises Local Appearance Consistency (LAC), which estimates appearance similarity under illumination and color changes, and Local Geometric Correspondence (LGC), which estimates spatial correspondence under viewpoint changes. LEV returns structured scalar evidence that the MLLM integrates for the final decision. We further introduce an auxiliary-capped reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) strategy, in which answer correctness dominates auxiliary tool-use and format signals, enabling the policy to learn when verification is necessary. Experiments show that LocalAgent improves mean accuracy by 4.9% over the strongest CoT-RFT baseline while invoking a verifier on only 12.13% of samples and preserving the general multimodal capabilities of the underlying MLLM. The open-source repository is available at https://github.com/Firefly-zoo/LocalAgent-main.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LocalAgent，一个结合通用多模态大语言模型和轻量级专业验证器的协作智能体框架，以解决MLLM在细粒度实例级一致性验证中的困难。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在判断两张图片是否为同一物理对象的实例级一致性验证任务上表现不佳，因为该任务不仅需要全局语义感知，还需要对微小可疑局部区域进行精确检查。
AI.method: 提出LocalAgent框架，由MLLM全局推理定位可疑局部区域，并交由局部证据验证器（LEV）工具包进行细粒度外观（LAC）和几何（LGC）匹配；LEV返回结构化标量证据供MLLM整合并决策。同时引入辅助上限强化微调（RFT）策略，使模型学习何时需调用验证器。
AI.result: 实验表明，LocalAgent相比最强的CoT-RFT基线平均准确率提升了4.9%，且仅在12.13%的样本上调用了验证器，同时保留了底层MLLM的通用多模态能力。
AI.conclusion: LocalAgent通过结合全局推理与局部细粒度验证，有效提升了实例级一致性验证的准确率，并在保持模型通用能力的同时实现了验证器调用的稀疏性。

title: InterWebCoder: Learning Interactive Webpage Generation from Executable Tests via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Interactive webpages underpin modern applications, but reproducing both their visual appearance and multi-step behavior remains challenging for multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Scalable training data must capture user actions, state transitions, and expected outcomes, while real-world webpage code is often entangled with irrelevant scripts and external dependencies. Moreover, existing GUI-agent-based verification provides slow and potentially unstable functional feedback. To address these challenges, we propose InterWebCoder, an efficient framework for interactive webpage code generation. InterWebCoder introduces a Test-Specification-Guided and Execution-Verified Data Synthesis pipeline that records real-world interaction trajectories and synthesizes self-contained webpage code with executable test scripts. A failureattributed repair mechanism uses runtime evidence to locate and iteratively fix errors in either the webpage code or test script. We then combine test-ID-weighted supervised fine-tuning with group-relative policy optimization, directly optimizing functional correctness and visual fidelity using test pass rates and state-level visual similarity. This replaces costly GUI-agent verification with fast, reproducible executable feedback. Our pipeline produces 1,736 verified samples from 2,058 tasks, achieving an 84.35% synthesis success rate. On IWR-Bench and Vision2Web, InterWebCoder achieves final scores of 48.54 and 48.42 with a 9B backbone, outperforming 30B-level models and Gemini-3.7-Flash while remaining competitive with Claude-Sonnet-5. It reduces reward-computation latency by over 97%, eliminates external MLLM verification costs, and accelerates end-to-end training by up to 1.4x.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了InterWebCoder框架，通过记录真实交互轨迹并结合执行验证与修复机制，高效生成具有视觉和功能正确性的交互式网页代码。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在重现交互式网页的视觉外观和多步行为时面临挑战，现有数据合成难以捕捉状态转换，且GUI代理验证缓慢且不稳定。
AI.method: 提出一种测试规范引导和执行验证的数据合成管道，记录真实交互轨迹并生成自带测试脚本的自包含网页代码；同时引入失败归因修复机制迭代修复错误，并结合测试ID加权监督微调与组相对策略优化（GRPO）优化功能正确性和视觉保真度。
AI.result: 在2058个任务中成功合成1736个验证样本（成功率84.35%）；在9B模型下，IWR-Bench和Vision2Web得分分别达48.54和48.42，超越30B级模型和Gemini-3.7-Flash，并与Claude-Sonnet-5表现相当；此外，奖励计算延迟降低超97%，端到端训练加速1.4倍。
AI.conclusion: InterWebCoder用快速、可复现的执行反馈替代了成本高昂的GUI代理验证，在交互式网页代码生成任务中实现了高效且极具竞争力的性能。

title: Code2Video-Compass: A Comprehensive Benchmark for General-Purpose Code-Based Video Generation across T2V, I2V, and V2V
summary: Code-based video generation offers fine-grained control, targeted editing, and component reuse compared with direct video generation. This approach requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to translate visual and temporal requirements into executable programs that produce complete videos. However, existing code-based benchmarks primarily target specialized tasks, leaving complete video creation across diverse creative categories and input modalities insufficiently evaluated. We introduce Code2Video-Compass, a general-purpose benchmark for code-based video generation across text-to-video (T2V), image-to-video (I2V), and video-to-video (V2V) settings. Code2Video-Compass comprises 2,104 tasks spanning 10 categories, 24 subtypes, and three complexity dimensions covering construction, dynamic animation, and state dependency. It combines tasks curated from textual instructions and visual references with corresponding T2V, I2V, and V2V tasks derived from complete professional and user-created videos. We propose a dual-level evaluation framework combining 12 objective metrics and five subjective metrics. Objective evaluation covers operational performance, video quality, text-video alignment, and reference fidelity, while subjective evaluation uses an MLLM judge to evaluate instruction following and holistic video quality. Extensive evaluation of 15 recent proprietary and open-weight MLLMs from nine families reveals that even leading models face challenges in reliably generating high-quality complete videos aligned with textual and visual requirements, with performance generally declining as construction, dynamic animation, and state-dependency complexity increases. We anticipate that Code2Video-Compass will advance reliable, coherent, and controllable code-based video generation and inspire broader progress in programmatic visual creation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个名为Code2Video-Compass的通用基准，用于评估基于代码的文本到视频、图像到视频和视频到视频生成任务。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于代码的视频生成基准主要针对特定任务，缺乏对跨多种创意类别和输入模态的完整视频创建进行全面评估的手段。
AI.method: 构建了包含2104个任务的Code2Video-Compass基准，涵盖10个类别、24个子类型及3个复杂性维度，并提出结合12个客观指标与5个主观指标的双层评估框架。
AI.result: 对9个家族的15个多模态大语言模型进行广泛评估，发现即使是最先进的模型在可靠生成符合文本和视觉要求的高质量完整视频方面仍存在困难，且性能随构建、动态动画和状态依赖复杂度的增加而下降。
AI.conclusion: Code2Video-Compass基准将推动可靠、连贯且可控的基于代码的视频生成技术发展，并激发程序化视觉创造领域的更广泛进步。

title: DIVE: Benchmarking Full-Duplex Interaction with Visual Engagement in Continuous Streams
summary: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have substantially improved spoken interaction and video understanding. Existing online and streaming benchmarks primarily assess causal multimodal perception through timestamped question answering, whereas real-world interaction requires models to continuously identify task-relevant multimodal cues and decide whether, when, and how to respond. This leaves open how well current models can sustain real-time interaction throughout an evolving multimodal stream. To address this gap, we introduce DIVE, a benchmark for evaluating full-duplex interaction with visual engagement under continuous and realistic multimodal streams. It organizes six tasks into three complementary interaction scenarios. (1) Proactive Intervention evaluates whether models can identify emerging visual or semantic cues and intervene at the appropriate moment. (2) Continuous Engagement evaluates sustained participation through continuous visual tracking and visually grounded query interaction. (3) Interaction Coordination evaluates how models coordinate listening and speaking under overlapping and multi-party interactions. DIVE contains 525 audio/video samples with fine-grained human annotations and precise temporal metadata. Its evaluation protocol separates response quality, participation decisions, and response timing. We evaluate representative real-time models using response quality, window response rates, and reaction latency. Experiments show that leading real-time models achieve sub-second average response latency, yet their average window response rates remain at or below 53.77%. Response quality varies substantially across models and tasks, with adapting ongoing responses to newly arriving information remaining particularly challenging. We hope DIVE facilitates progress toward more natural and capable real-time multimodal interactive systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DIVE基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在连续多模态流中的全双工视觉交互能力。
AI.motivation: 现有流式基准主要通过时间戳问答评估感知能力，缺乏对模型在持续演进的多模态流中维持实时交互的评估，无法满足真实世界中需要模型持续识别线索并决定如何响应的需求。
AI.method: 提出DIVE基准，包含525个音视频样本及精细标注。通过主动干预、持续参与和交互协调三个场景下的六项任务进行评估，并将响应质量、参与决策和响应时机分离评测。
AI.result: 实验显示，领先实时模型的平均响应延迟在亚秒级，但平均窗口响应率最高仅为53.77%；模型在适应新到达信息以调整正在进行的响应方面仍面临重大挑战。
AI.conclusion: DIVE揭示了当前模型在实时多模态交互中的不足，有望推动更自然、更强大的实时交互系统的发展。

title: Auto-Director: Leveraging Multi-Agent Collaboration for Autonomous Video Editing
summary: Autonomous video editing from open-world resources remains a challenging problem in multimedia content creation. Retrieval-based methods are constrained by fixed source material and lack creative flexibility, while generative models struggle with long-horizon coherence and often diverge from user intent. Both paradigms fail to replicate the structured, multi-stage reasoning that underlies professional post-production. To address these limitations, we present Auto-Director, a tool-augmented multi-agent framework that mirrors professional editorial workflows: a Planning Agent decomposes abstract topics into fact-grounded scripts via retrieval-augmented planning; a Material Agent indexes open-world footage through shot segmentation and visual tagging; an Editor Agent assembles semantically aligned clips with MLLM-driven spatial adaptation; and a Critic Agent governs an iterative Reflect-and-Revise loop that checks scene-level alignment and pacing. To rigorously evaluate this new paradigm, we introduce VEdit-Bench, a benchmark of 100 expert-curated topics with human-annotated Golden Scripts and a five-dimensional metric suite covering Narrative Logic, Factual Accuracy, Semantic Alignment, Compositional Quality, and Stylistic Cohesion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Auto-Director significantly outperforms baseline methods in both automated metrics and human evaluation, effectively bridging the gap between amateurs and professional-grade video production.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了Auto-Director，一个模拟专业编辑工作流的工具增强型多智能体框架，用于从开放世界资源中进行自动视频剪辑，并引入了VEdit-Bench基准进行评估。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于检索的方法缺乏创意灵活性，而生成模型在长程连贯性上存在困难且易偏离用户意图，两者都无法复制专业后期制作中的结构化多阶段推理过程。
AI.method: 提出Auto-Director多智能体框架，包含规划智能体（通过检索增强生成事实脚本）、素材智能体（镜头分割与视觉标记）、剪辑智能体（MLLM驱动的片段组装与空间适应）和评审智能体（迭代反思与修改循环以确保场景对齐与节奏）。
AI.result: 实验表明，Auto-Director在自动评估指标和人工评估中均显著优于基线方法，有效缩小了业余与专业级视频制作之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: Auto-Director成功通过多智能体协作模拟了专业视频后期制作流程，为多媒体内容创作提供了一个有效且高质量的新范式。
